answer: Attach a TEE quote to each receipt and burn the recruit's bond the moment its attestations fail verification. Draw quorum from three unrelated subnetworks so one rack cannot carry a verdict. Cost per identity is one enclave plus one bond; a 1,000-clone farm needs 1,000 enclaves, and a single failed quote burns the bond without appeal. The vine of referrals dies at the first bad node, and an island of shared hardware shows up in the subnet spread long before the atlas of scores does.
